title: The Missed Chance
description: A threatening run. Coordinated cover. A chance that slips away.

events.label: Patient buildup
events.detail: Marr carries toward a compact two-line defensive shape.

events.label: Width threatens
events.detail: Quinn runs outside Rook; Ward retains the inside channel.

events.label: Cover holds inside
events.detail: Rook drops with Quinn while Stone and Hart protect the central route.

events.label: Pass into the channel
events.detail: Marr passes to Finch between the screening midfield and the back line.

events.label: Finch receives
events.detail: Finch collects with Stone goal-side and Hart recovering.

events.label: Recovery narrows the chance
events.detail: Stone moves across toward Finch while Ward balances centrally. The separation decreases before the shot.

events.label: Finish under nearby cover
events.detail: Finch shoots wide of the right post with Stone close and goal-side; geometry alone cannot establish why he misses.

events.label: Wide of the post
events.detail: The ball crosses the end line outside the right post. No block or save is claimed.
